title: Impact of Very-Low-Birth-Weight Classification on Neonatal Mortality
research_question: Does being classified as very-low-birth-weight impact neonatal mortality rates? This study investigates whether crossing the birth weight threshold for this classification influences the log of neonatal mortality.
data_description: The dataset includes 500 observations with columns: running_var (birth weight in grams), treated (indicator for very-low-birth-weight classification), and y (log neonatal mortality). Observations are concentrated around the classification threshold.
